tagline: Leading global metal beverage can manufacturer with focus on sustainable packaging solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Robust 18.7% year-on-year revenue growth in the metal packaging sector, reflecting sustained demand for aluminum cans despite pricing pressures and raw material cost fluctuations.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from the sale of metal beverage cans and packaging products.
kpis.description: Revenue increased 18.7% year-over-year, rising from 1.268 billion dollars to 1.504 billion dollars for the quarter ending March 31, 2026.
kpis.signal: Strong year-over-year revenue growth driven by volume and price increases.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue, reflecting manufacturing efficiency and pricing power.
kpis.description: Gross margin stood at 11.9% in March 2026 compared to 11.1% one year prior, demonstrating effective cost pass-through mechanisms despite elevated material and energy costs.
kpis.signal: Modest improvement in gross margin despite input cost pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit from core operations before interest, taxes and exceptional items.
kpis.description: Operating profit increased from 41 million dollars to 56 million dollars year-over-year, representing 36.6% growth driven by improved margins and cost control measures.
kpis.signal: Operating profit growth outpacing revenue growth indicates improving operational leverage.

kpis.name: Net Finance Expense
kpis.explanation: Total cost of debt and other finance charges net of finance income.
kpis.description: Net finance expenses increased by 10 million dollars year-over-year from 50 million dollars to 60 million dollars, reflecting elevated interest rate environment.
kpis.signal: Increased financial burden reflecting higher interest rates and debt levels.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss after all expenses, interest and income taxes for the reporting period.
kpis.description: Net loss remained stable at approximately 5 million dollars for the quarter ending March 31, 2026 compared to the prior year period.
kpis.signal: Net loss remains stable at modest level despite strong revenue growth.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company at period end.
kpis.description: Total assets decreased from 5.679 billion dollars to 5.424 billion dollars at March 31, 2026, a reduction of 255 million dollars year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Decline in total assets reflects balance sheet optimization and working capital management.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 4.42 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.52 Bn € in the latest year

risks.title: Overcapacity without corresponding demand
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Item 1A with strong language ("material adverse effect" repeated 4 times). Stable but structural trend: recent expansions in US, Europe, Brazil creating supply-demand imbalance. High category weight for mature sector.

risks.title: Customer concentration and reliance on top 10 clients
risks.score_rationale: Top 10 customers represent 57% of revenue (2025 data). High-intensity language on risk of customer loss and unfavorable renegotiation. Trend up: customer consolidation accelerating (Celsius, Carlsberg, Heineken acquisitions in 2025).

risks.title: Vertical integration of customers reducing external demand
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific risk: AB InBev (Metal Container Corp), Molson Coors (Rocky Mountain), Ball (Benepack acquisition 2026). Moderate but clear language on creation of competing capacity. Trend up with announced acquisitions.

risks.title: Competition from alternative packaging and shifting preferences
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk: competition from PET, glass, carton, composites. Moderate-to-high intensity language. Trend up: evolving consumer preferences (health, sustainability) and taxes on sugary/alcoholic beverages (France, UK, WHO recommendations 2025).

risks.title: Volatility in raw material costs and customs tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Major risk: aluminum is a critical input. High-intensity language on inability to pass through costs. Trend up: US tariffs on aluminum from Canada/Mexico announced February 2025, risk of trade retaliation.

risks.title: Energy supply instability and rising prices
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly linked to Russia-Ukraine war. Moderate-to-high intensity language. Stable but persistent trend: ongoing conflict affecting energy prices in Europe (key operational region for the group).

risks.title: Significant goodwill impairment risk (1 billion USD)
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill of 1 billion USD as of December 31, 2025. High-intensity language on risk of non-cash impairment. Trend up: deteriorating market conditions (overcapacity, competition, customer consolidation) increasing impairment risk.

risks.title: Seasonal demand and climate impacts on volumes
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk: strong seasonal demand in spring/summer (NA, Europe) and Q1/Q4 (Brazil). Moderate language. Trend up: climate change increasing frequency of abnormal weather conditions affecting demand.
